posts.title: Press the Blade to the Hilt
posts.description: Condottiere. Oh, Condottiere. Dominique Ehrhard’s classic game of battles-within-battles is over thirty years old. It’s been a part of the hobby longer than most of its current adherents, myself included. That’s old enough for any alterations to feel downright excommunicable.
